about_short_description.short_description: Infera is an AI and digital transformation company that develops machine learning engines for industries and businesses.

product.name: Optimizer Platform
product.description: A platform that uses machine learning to create probabilistic digital twins for system and process optimization, accounting for real-world uncertainties.

product.name: Process Optimization Services
product.description: Services that integrate machine learning with chemical and biological models to optimize industrial processes, offering predictive maintenance and quality assessment.

product.name: Data Management Module
product.description: A module for cleaning and managing data, facilitating experiment design to generate data for AI model refinement.

product.name: AI Model Construction
product.description: A module that automates the selection and construction of AI models using machine learning algorithms, providing predictions with calibrated error bars.

product.name: Virtual Metrology
product.description: A system using probabilistic inference to manage uncertainties in metrology, enhancing prediction accuracy and supporting root-cause analysis.
